newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's BBV aims to boost customer loans.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BBV aims to boost customer loans.

text.p: Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) is to launch an aggressive campaign to encourage customer loans in view of an expected improvement in private consumption.
"We intend to take advantage of a higher number of cars sold and we intend to anticipate the pick-up in consumption," said general director Jose Ignacio Goirigolzarri on Tuesday.

BBV is offering loans with interest rates starting at 9.75 percent. The director added BBV will invest around 750 million pesetas in advertising, but added the bank does not intend to start a price war with its competitors.
